answer_2.quote: To evaluate the effectiveness of topic models, the preponderance of topic modeling literature rely on automated coherence metrics.

answer_4.quote: we design and conduct a user study, which is the keystone of our work (see Section 6).
answer_4.guideline: Users are tasked to cluster words in t_j,i that they deem similar to form coherent word groups g, where their response R_u,j,i to t_j,i is a set of unique g. We constrain each word to only belong to one coherent word group to limit the task complexity. Additionally, a word considered to be unrelated may form its group of one.
